items.korean: 환불은 청구가 중복된 것으로 확인될 경우에만 가능합니다. 스크린샷 제출은 선택 사항입니다. 전체 카드 번호는 포함하지 마세요. 현재로서는 귀하의 청구가 중복되었는지 여부를 확인할 수 없습니다.

error.message:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  [
+   'We confirmed that the charge was duplicated. You are eligible for a refund. We will process the refund after you confirm the transaction ID.\n' +
+     '\n' +
+     'A screenshot is still optional.'
-   'We confirmed that the charge was duplicated. You are eligible for a refund. We will process the refund after you confirm the transaction ID. A screenshot is still optional.'
  ]
